name: worktree-guard
description: Lightweight Git and native-edit accident prevention for base checkouts.

interface.shortDescription: Keep agent mutations out of base checkouts.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight accident-prevention hook that blocks six risky Git commands and harness-native file writes in Git base checkouts. Linked worktrees remain available for mutations.
defaultPrompt: Use linked worktrees for file edits and risky Git operations.
